**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

Section 12 provides an express warranty that the Software will conform to the Specifications in all material respects for the acceptance period **plus one year** from the Maintenance Commencement Date, and continuing for as long as the Software remains under Maintenance Services. That exceeds the playbook's preferred 12-month software warranty.

Supporting elements:
- **Remedy** — § 10(c) requires Garman to repair non-conforming Software at no additional charge (p0077); §§ 7–8 allow rejection during acceptance with return of "any and all amounts paid to Garman hereunder" (full refund).
- **No disclaimer risk** — the agreement contains no "AS IS" language and no disclaimer of implied warranties, so nothing swallows the express warranty. § 15 preserves recovery of direct damages.

Noted in the rationale but not flagged as deviations (minor sub-elements only): no separate professional-and-workmanlike warranty for installation/training/maintenance services, no no-malicious-code or compliance-with-laws warranty, and post-acceptance repair is qualified by "best efforts" without an express replace-or-refund alternative. These are worth raising conversationally if the deal is reopened, but they do not justify a redline against a warranty that already sits above the preferred position on duration and remedy.
